meta.description: Plan 2.5: v8 DeepONet checkpoint certified as a candidate of the v9 exact-assembly system (A_I, no EIM/allowance) at N = 64, N_T = 60 on bench120. Bounds are augmented (beta0 included), true error = max_n mass-norm error vs dense LU reference, same units.
meta.inputs: v8 code: normalize_mu (log C,G,M), psi = european_put projection, c0 = compute_initial_coefficients; production_dataset.h5 not needed

decision.criterion: retrain only if v8_frozen/models/training_code_at_checkpoint_commit_13bf0d5/ runs unchanged against the new N = 64 references (follow-up 1, section 3)
reasons: train_final_models.py -> generate_production_dataset.build_val_set regenerates the validation set with the v8 trusted solver generate_one_sample(mode='toeplitz'), i.e. the principal-period assembly; running it unchanged violates CLAUDE_PHASE2.md rule 2

load_all_train_samples reads v8's HDF5 schema (data.dataset.read_trajectory, raw 66-dof coefficients incl. boundary rows); the new references are npz free-coefficient files, so the script cannot read them unchanged
decision.evidence: old checkpoint on bench120 (this file): 120/120 rejected at every eps in 1e-3 x {0.1,...,10}; median true error 0.78 (relative 3.1e-3), median eta^S 3.4; no false accepts
